I'm Jon, an independent web designer based in Bordeaux[[bordeaux]] — originally from Jersey[[jersey]], with stints living in Paris and Brighton along the way. I've been designing and building for the web for over 25 years, working across strategy, design and development, which is a slightly unusual combination for a designer.

Outside of work I'm a keen street photographer (Leica in hand, sorry not sorry), I collect photography books, I love to travel — usually towards places with a dodgy reputation — and there's almost always music on while I work.
